scope: Research reconciliation; this board does not itself publish candidate map pins

standards.publication: Map pins require an independently identifiable real physical site, exact published coordinates with source, credible institutional or custodian identity source, English and French description and source-registry entry
standards.textual_match: Name similarity cannot certify same physical site and must not create new or overwrite existing pins
standards.research: Discovery-source tally is editorial cross-listing, not a verified count of site-specific original primary-source URLs
standards.category: Ordinary Catholic churches, cathedrals, juridical shrines, apparition claims and places of other custodianship are distinct; no upgrade of ecclesial status by inference
standards.next_pass: Breadth first: review all 750 candidates country by country, reconcile existing identities, publish site-verified global batches and only later add extra photographic galleries
standards.release_guard: No new Mass times, no TLM Directory assumption, no Bible Atlas modification
